create_equivariant_layer_norm: create an EquivariantLayerNormArray module to normalize equivariant features of shape N sphere_basis C per degree L
create_layer_norm_spherical_harmonics: create an EquivariantLayerNormArraySphericalHarmonics module to normalize L=0 separately and all L>0 m components together
create_rms_norm_spherical_harmonics: create an EquivariantRMSNormArraySphericalHarmonicsV2 module to RMS normalize all degrees with optional centering and degree balancing
build_normalization_layer_factory: build a normalization layer using get_normalization_layer with norm_type lmax and num_channels parameters
create_degree_layer_scale: create an EquivariantDegreeLayerScale module to scale equivariant features by degree with learnable affine weights
